title: 농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 농림축산식품부 (그린바이오산업팀), 044-201-2140, 2141
rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Green Bio-industry Team ), 044-201-2140, 2141

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural Biological Resources and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(기본계획ㆍ시행계획의 공표) 농림축산식품부장관은 「농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제5조제5항에 따라 같은 조 제1항 및 제3항에 따른 농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 기본계획 및 시행계획을 수립한 때에는 그 내용을 농림축산식품부의 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하는 방법으로 공표해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Publication of Basic Plan and Implementation Plan) When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs establishes a basic plan and an implementation plan for the conservation, management, and use of agricultural biological resources pursuant to Article 5(5) of the Act on the Conservation, Management, and Use of Agricultural Biological Resources (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), he or she shall publish the contents thereof by posting them on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

[This Article was newly added on Nov. 20, 2020.]
[Former Article 2 was moved to Article 2-2 <Nov. 20, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(농업생명자원의 조사ㆍ등재 등) ① 법 제6조제1항에 따라 농촌진흥청장, 산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장은 현지내보존 및 현지외보존의 상태에 있는 농업생명자원의 현황 조사ㆍ수집 계획을 매년 수립ㆍ시행해야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 6. 28., 2020. 11. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Survey and Registration, etc. of Agricultural Biological Resources) ① Pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, and the Administrator of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency shall annually formulate and implement a plan for the survey of the current status and collection of agricultural biological resources in the state of in-situ and ex-situ conservation. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 28, 2017; Nov. 20, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 농촌진흥청장, 산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장은 법 제6조제3항에 따라 목록을 작성하는 경우에는 자원명, 학명(學名), 수집자, 수집 지역 등이 포함되도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, and the Administrator of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency prepare a list pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 3 of the Act , they shall ensure that the resource name, scientific name, collector, collection region, etc. are included. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 농촌진흥청장, 산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장은 법 제6조제4항에 따라 제2항에 따른 농업생명자원의 목록 중에서 보존가치가 있는 농업생명자원을 보존목록에 등재하는 경우에는 자원번호, 등급 구분, 보존연도, 보존방법 등이 포함되도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ In accordance with Article 6, Paragraph 4 of the Act , when the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, and the Administrator of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency list agricultural biological resources of conservation value from the list of agricultural biological resources under Paragraph 2 in the conservation list, they shall ensure that the resource number, grade classification, conservation year, conservation method, etc. are included. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 28, 2017>

Article 2 (Scope of Statistical Surveys) Pursuant to Article 9 of the Act, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may conduct the following statistical surveys related to the food industry. <Amended July 20, 2012; March 23, 2013; July 8, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(농업생명자원의 분석ㆍ평가 등) ① 법 제7조제1항에 따른 농업생명자원의 분석ㆍ평가 항목은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Analysis and Evaluation, etc. of Agricultural Biological Resources) ① The items for the analysis and evaluation of agricultural biological resources pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows: <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 학명, 재배, 양식 및 사육 내용 등 기초적인 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Basic information such as scientific name, cultivation, farming, and rearing details

rows.source_ko: 2. 생육 및 생산 과정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning growth and production processes

rows.source_ko: 3. 분류학적ㆍ형태적ㆍ기능적 특성
rows.text_en: 3. Taxonomic, morphological, and functional characteristics

rows.source_ko: 4. 병충해 및 재해에 대한 저항성
rows.text_en: 4. Resistance to pests, diseases, and natural disasters

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 농업생명자원 책임기관의 장이 분석ㆍ평가를 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 항목
rows.text_en: 5. Other items deemed necessary for analysis and evaluation by the head of the responsible institution for agricultural and biological resources

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제7조제1항에 따른 농업생명자원의 보존가치 등급을 부여하기 위한 등급기준은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The grading criteria for assigning conservation value grades to agricultural biological resources pursuant to Article 7 , Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended June 28, 2017>
[Title amended June 28, 2017]
Article 4 Deleted <June 28, 2017>
Article 5 Deleted <June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(관리기관의 지정 등) ① 영 제10조제2항에 따른 농업생명자원 관리기관 지정신청서는 별지 제3호서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Designation of Management Agency, etc.) ①The application form for the designation of an agricultural and biological resource management agency pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Register . <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제10조제5항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 농업생명자원 관리기관 지정서는 별지 제4호서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of designation for an agricultural and biological resource management institution pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 10, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form . <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제11조제1항에 따른 농업생명자원 관리기관 갱신신청서는 별지 제5호서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ The application form for renewal of an agricultural biological resource management institution pursuant to Article 11 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form . <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(분양승인의 신청 등) ① 영 제13조제1항에 따른 농업생명자원 분양신청서는 별지 제6호서식 또는 별지 제7호서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Approval of Distribution, etc.) ①The application form for the distribution of agricultural biological resources pursuant to Article 13 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 or Form No. 7 of the Appendix. <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제13조제4항에 따른 농업생명자원 분양승인서는 별지 제8호서식 또는 별지 제9호서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The approval certificate for the distribution of agricultural biological resources pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 or Form No. 9 of the Attached Form . <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(국외반출승인의 기준) ① 법 제18조제1항에 따라 국외반출승인을 받으려는 농업생명자원은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 기준에 맞아야 한다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Criteria for Approval for Export) ① Agricultural biological resources for which approval for export is sought pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall meet any of the criteria set forth in the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「종자산업법」이나 「특허법」 등에 따른 육성자의 권리 보호에 지장이 없을 것
rows.text_en: 1. There shall be no impediment to the protection of the breeder's rights under the Seed Industry Act or the Patent Act , etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 외국과의 협약에 따라 반출하는 야생종 및 재래종일 것
rows.text_en: 2. Must be wild or native species exported in accordance with agreements with foreign countries.

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 국내 농업생물다양성을 유지ㆍ보존하기 위하여 필요하다고 인정되는 기준
rows.text_en: 3. Other standards deemed necessary to maintain and preserve domestic agricultural biodiversity

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 국외반출승인의 세부 기준은 농촌진흥청장, 산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장이 각각 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The detailed standards for approval of export abroad pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be determined and announced by the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, and the Administrator of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, respectively . <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(국외반출의 신청 절차 등) ① 법 제18조제1항에 따라 농업생명자원을 국외로 반출하려는 자는 별지 제10호서식 또는 별지 제11호서식에 따른 농업생명자원 국외반출 신청서에 농업생명자원 국외반출 신청목록을 첨부하여 농촌진흥청장, 산림청장 또는 농림축산검역본부장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Procedures for Application for Export Abroad, etc.) ①Any person who intends to export agricultural biological resources abroad pursuant to Article 18 , Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for the export of agricultural biological resources abroad in accordance with Form No. 10 or Form No. 11 of the Appendix , attached with a list of applications for the export of agricultural biological resources abroad, to the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, or the Head of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 농촌진흥청장, 산림청장 또는 농림축산검역본부장은 제1항에 따른 농업생명자원 국외반출승인의 신청을 받았을 때에는 국외반출승인의 기준에 적합한지를 심사한 후 기준에 적합할 경우에는 별지 제12호서식 또는 별지 제13호서식의 농업생명자원 국외반출 승인서 또는 농업생명자원 조건부 국외반출 승인서를 신청인에게 내주어야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, or the Administrator of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency receives an application for approval of the export of agricultural biological resources pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall examine whether the application meets the criteria for approval of export; if it meets the criteria, they shall issue to the applicant an Approval Certificate for the Export of Agricultural Biological Resources or a Conditional Approval Certificate for the Export of Agricultural Biological Resources in the form of Annex No. 12 or Annex No. 13. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 농촌진흥청장, 산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장은 제2항에 따른 심사를 한 결과 국외반출승인을 하기에 적합하지 아니한 경우에는 지체 없이 그 사유를 구체적으로 밝혀 신청인에게 알려야 한다. 다만, 부적합한 사항이 단기간에 보완될 수 있다고 인정되면 보완을 조건으로 국외반출승인을 할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ If, as a result of the examination conducted pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, and the Administrator of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency determine that the application is not suitable for approval of export abroad, they shall notify the applicant without delay, specifying the reasons in detail. However, if it is deemed that the unsuitable matters can be rectified within a short period, approval for export abroad may be granted on the condition that such rectification is made. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(국외반출승인대상목록의 작성 대상 및 방법) ① 법 제18조제2항에 따라 국외반출승인대상목록 작성의 대상이 되는 농업생명자원은 별표 1에 따른 보존가치 등급이 1등급 또는 2등급인 농업생명자원으로 한다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Subjects and Method of Preparing the List of Approvals for Export) ①Agricultural biological resources subject to the preparation of the List of Approvals for Export Pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be agricultural biological resources with a conservation value grade of Grade 1 or Grade 2 as specified in Annex 1. <Amended Jun. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 국외반출승인대상목록에는 국외반출승인대상 농업생명자원의 과명(科名)ㆍ학명ㆍ작물명이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2017. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The list of items subject to approval for export under Paragraph 1 shall include the family name, scientific name, and crop name of the agricultural biological resources subject to approval for export. <Amended June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(해외자원개발 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 제공 업무 시행기관의 지정 기준) 영 제19조제3항에 따른 시행기관의 지정 기준은 별표 3과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Criteria for Designation of Implementing Agency for Collection, Analysis, and Provision of Information on Overseas Resource Development) The criteria for designation of an implementing agency pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree are as set forth in Appendix 3 .

rows.source_ko: 제12조(규제의 재검토) 농림축산식품부장관은 제10조 및 별표 1에 따른 국외반출승인대상목록의 작성 대상 및 방법에 대하여 2017년 1월 1일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 기준일과 같은 날 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall review the validity of the subjects and methods for compiling the list of items subject to approval for export abroad pursuant to Article 10 and Annex 1 every three years starting from January 1, 2017 (meaning up to the day before the same date as the reference date of every third year) and take measures such as improvements.
[Wholly revised Aug. 7, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <농림수산식품부령 제298호, 2012. 7. 24.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 298, July 24, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2012년 7월 26일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on July 26, 2012.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(보존가치 등급에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따라 보존가치 등급을 부여받은 농업유전자원은 제3조제2항의 개정규정에 따라 보존가치 등급을 부여받은 농수산생명자원으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Conservation Value Grades)  Agricultural genetic resources that were assigned a conservation value grade under the previous regulations at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to be agricultural and fishery biological resources that have been assigned a conservation value grade under the amended provisions of Article 3, Paragraph 2.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(다른 법률의 개정에 관한 경과조치) 별표 1 제1호나목의 개정규정 중 “「야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제2조제2호에 따른 멸종위기 야생생물”은 2012년 7월 28일까지는 “「야생동ㆍ식물보호법」 제2조제2호에 따른 멸종위기야생동ㆍ식물”로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Amendments to Other Acts)  Among the amended provisions of Subparagraph 1, Item (b) of Annex 1, “endangered wild animals and plants pursuant to Article 2, Item 2 of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act” shall be deemed to be “endangered wild animals and plants pursuant to Article 2, Item 2 of the Wildlife Protection Act” until July 28, 2012.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <농림축산식품부령 제8호, 해양수산부령 제8호, 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 8, Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 8, Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <농림축산식품부령 제129호, 해양수산부령 제133호, 2015. 1. 6.> (규제 재검토기한 설정 등을 위한 가축전염병 예방법 시행규칙 등 일부개정령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 129, Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 133, Jan. 6, 2015> (Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Infectious Diseases of Livestock Act, etc. for the Establishment of Regulatory Review Periods, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 생략
rows.text_en: Article 2  omitted

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2017년 6월 28일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on June 28, 2017.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) 농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제명 “농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙”을 “농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: The title “Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources” shall be changed to “Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural Biological Resources”.

rows.source_ko: 제1조 중 “「농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」”을 “「농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 1, “the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources” shall be changed to “the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural Biological Resources”.

rows.source_ko: 제2조의 제목 중 “농수산생명자원”을 “농업생명자원”으로 하고, 같은 조 제1항 중 “「농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」(이하 "법"이라 한다)”을 “「농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」(이하 "법"이라 한다)”로, “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로, “농수산생명자원의 현황”을 “농업생명자원의 현황”으로 하며, 같은 조 제2항 중 “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로 하고, 같은 조 제3항 중 “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로, “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the title of Article 2, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources”; in Paragraph 1 of the same Article, “the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)” shall be changed to “the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural Biological Resources (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)”; “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service, the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, and the Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service and the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”; and “the current status of agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “the current status of agricultural biological resources”; in Paragraph 2 of the same Article, “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service, the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, and the Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service and the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”; and in Paragraph 3 of the same Article, “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service, the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, and the Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service and the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”. “Agricultural and fisheries biological resources” shall be changed to “Agricultural biological resources” respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제3조의 제목, 같은 조 제1항 각 호 외의 부분, 같은 항 제5호 및 같은 조 제2항 중 “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the title of Article 3, the part other than the subparagraphs of Paragraph 1 of the same article, Subparagraph 5 of the same paragraph, and Paragraph 2 of the same article, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources.”

rows.source_ko: 제4조 및 제5조를 각각 삭제한다.
rows.text_en: Articles 4 and 5 are deleted.

rows.source_ko: 제6조제1항부터 제3항까지 및 제7조제1항ㆍ제2항 중 “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 6, paragraphs 1 through 3, and Article 7, paragraphs 1 and 2, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources”.

rows.source_ko: 제8조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 중 “농수산생명자원”을 “농업생명자원”으로 하고, 같은 항 제3호 중 “농수산생물다양성”을 “농업생물다양성”으로 하며, 같은 조 제2항 중 “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 8, Paragraph 1, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources,” and in Subparagraph 3 of the same paragraph, “agricultural and fishery biodiversity” shall be changed to “agricultural biodiversity,” and in Paragraph 2 of the same article, “Minister of the Korea Forest Service, Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency and Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “Minister of the Korea Forest Service and Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency.”

rows.source_ko: 제9조제1항 및 같은 조 제2항 본문 중 “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로, “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 또는 국립수산과학원장”을 각각 “산림청장 또는 농림축산검역본부장”으로 하고, 같은 조 제2항 단서를 삭제하며, 같은 조 제3항 본문 중 “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the main text of Article 9, Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 2, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources” and “Minister of the Korea Forest Service, Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, or Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “Minister of the Korea Forest Service or Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”; the proviso to Paragraph 2 of the same article shall be deleted; and in the main text of Paragraph 3 of the same article, “Minister of the Korea Forest Service, Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, and Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “Minister of the Korea Forest Service and Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”.

rows.source_ko: 제10조제1항 및 제2항 중 “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 10, Paragraphs 1 and 2, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources” respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제12조 각 호 외의 부분 중 “농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관”을 “농림축산식품부장관”으로 하고, 같은 조 제1호 중 “농수산생명자원”을 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 12, “Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” shall be changed to “Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs,” and in subparagraph 1 of the same article, “agricultural and fisheries biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources.”

rows.source_ko: 별표 1의 제목 중 “농수산생명자원”을 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the title of Attached Table 1, “Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources” shall be changed to “Agricultural Biological Resources”.

rows.text_en: Delete asterisk 2.

rows.text_en: In subparagraphs (a) and (b) of Item 1 of Table 3, “overseas agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “overseas agricultural biological resources” respectively, and in subparagraph (b) of the same item, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources”, and in the main text of Item 2 of the same table, “agricultural, forestry, fishery food sector” shall be changed to “agricultural, forestry, and food sector” and “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources”, and in the proviso of the same item, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources”.
